description: This Java class serves as a wrapper around the CodeValueRepository, providing methods to retrieve CodeValue objects with built-in not-found exception handling. It simplifies repository usage by centralizing null checks and exception throwing.

classes.name: CodeValueRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that provides safe access to CodeValueRepository methods, throwing custom exceptions when CodeValue entities are not found.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a CodeValue by ID, throwing CodeValueNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: findOneByCodeNameAndIdWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a CodeValue by code name and ID, throwing CodeValueNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: findOneByCodeNameAndLabelWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a CodeValue by code name and label, throwing CodeValueNotFoundException if not found.
